summary: Verified the termos.html logo (brasão) bug fix for both PMPE and CBMPE at desktop (1400x900) and mobile (390x844) viewports via Playwright. All 4/4 cases passed: img#t-logo has valid src, complete=true, naturalWidth>0 (PMPE 300px, CBMPE 80px). No JS console/page errors (specifically no 'Cannot set properties of null'). Regression fields (h2#t-orgao, span#t-edital2) populate correctly, and the removed ul.termos-info block does NOT reappear. Logo image files return HTTP 200 image/jpeg.
critical_code_review_comments: termos.html inline script fix confirmed: orphan 'document.getElementById(\'t-vagas\').textContent' line removed, so lg.src=d.logo now executes. Good RCA by main agent.
Minor: the .termos-info CSS rules (lines 30-33, 51) are now dead CSS since the DOM block was removed - could be cleaned up but harmless.
context_for_next_testing_agent: termos.html logo bug fully fixed and verified. Test validates img#t-logo src/complete/naturalWidth, orgao, edital2, absence of ul.termos-info, and zero page errors for ?c=pmpe and ?c=cbmpe at desktop+mobile. Use wait_until='domcontentloaded' (NOT networkidle) when loading this page - a chat widget keeps the network busy and networkidle times out.
rca of the issue: RCA (confirmed): removing the ul.termos-info block also removed strong#t-vagas, but the inline script still called document.getElementById('t-vagas').textContent = d.vagas which threw 'Cannot set properties of null', halting script execution before lg.src=d.logo ran -> blank logo. Fix: removed the orphan t-vagas line. Verified: both concursos render logos correctly at both viewports with no page errors.
